PageSubtitle: Solve a deterministic layout, inspect it, then add it directly to the open module.
PlacementHint: Clear routes reserves 2.5m paths with wider prop spacing. Compact reserves 1.2m paths with closer spacing. Both check footprints and support.
DensityHint: Density is a target. Props that cannot fit safely are omitted and counted below the preview.
ShowFootprintsTip: Purple circles show prop footprints, cyan shows floor decoration, and gray boxes show building bounds. These are clearance estimates, not model outlines.
ShowRoutesTip: Gold bands show the paths reserved through rooms and along roads. Width follows the selected placement option.
StatusInitial: The preview generates automatically when this window opens.
NoTilesets: No generator tilesets are available from the current game-data index.
StatusDisplayChanged: Preview display options changed. Updating the preview...
BusySolving: Solving the layout and validating encounters...
WaitForPreview: Wait for the current settings to finish previewing before creating the area.
BusyWriting: Writing the generated area into the open module...
WholeNumbers: Generator numeric settings must be whole numbers.
ResRefInvalid: ResRef must be 1-{0} characters, lowercase letters/digits/underscore only.
OmittedProps: Omitted {0} props: {1} unsupported, {2} near routes or anchors, {3} overlapping. Density is a target; clearance takes priority.
